function wallTile(x,y){

else if(up&&down)horizontal=false;

horizontal
?((y===0&&x===15)?'wall_poster':(y===0&&[7,23,29].includes(x))?'wall_red_stripe':'wall_horizontal')

function drawCheckoutIslands(){
const visited=new Set();
for(let y=0;y<H-1;y++)for(let x=0;x<W-1;x++){
if(tile(x,y)!=='К'||tile(x+1,y)!=='К'||tile(x,y+1)!=='К'||tile(x+1,y+1)!=='К')continue;
const key=x+','+y;
if(visited.has(key))continue;
const members=[[x,y],[x+1,y],[x,y+1],[x+1,y+1]];
if(members.some(([ix,iy])=>visited.has(ix+','+iy)))continue;
for(const [ix,iy] of members)visited.add(ix+','+iy);
texDraw('checkout_left_v043',x*TILE,y*TILE,TILE,2*TILE);
texDraw('checkout_right_v043',(x+1)*TILE,y*TILE,TILE,2*TILE);
}
// Solitary vertical lane (kept from the first island after the remodel).
for(let y=0;y<H-1;y++)for(let x=0;x<W;x++){
if(tile(x,y)!=='К'||tile(x,y+1)!=='К')continue;
if(visited.has(x+','+y)||visited.has(x+','+(y+1)))continue;
const leftPair = x>0 && tile(x-1,y)==='К' && tile(x-1,y+1)==='К';
const rightPair = x<W-1 && tile(x+1,y)==='К' && tile(x+1,y+1)==='К';
if(leftPair||rightPair) continue;
const sprite = (x>0 && tile(x-1,y)==='Р') ? 'checkout_right_v043' : 'checkout_left_v043';
texDraw(sprite,x*TILE,y*TILE,TILE,2*TILE);
visited.add(x+','+y); visited.add(x+','+(y+1));
}
}
const SHELF_CODES=new Set(['Д','А','Т','П','Б','С']);
function isShelfTile(x,y){return inside(x,y)&&SHELF_CODES.has(tile(x,y));}
function shelfSpriteFor(x,y){
// Double-wide vertical shelves: the first TWO cells (upper ends) are
// identical endcap modules. Other rows are backed against each other:
// LEFT column is accessible from the left, RIGHT column from the right.
let l=x;while(isShelfTile(l-1,y))l--;
let r=x;while(isShelfTile(r+1,y))r++;
if(r-l===1){
const sameAbove=isShelfTile(l,y-1)&&isShelfTile(r,y-1);
const sameBelow=isShelfTile(l,y+1)&&isShelfTile(r,y+1);
if(sameAbove||sameBelow){
if(!sameAbove)return x===l?'shelf_back_top_join_right':'shelf_back_top_join_left';
return x===l?'shelf_access_left_join_right':'shelf_access_right_join_left';
}
}
// A row backed by the north/top wall has its product access from below.
if(y===1&&tile(x,0)==='#')return 'shelf_back_top';
// If physically backed against an external sidewall, show one access face.
if(tile(x-1,y)==='#'&&!isShelfTile(x+1,y))return 'shelf_access_right';
if(tile(x+1,y)==='#'&&!isShelfTile(x-1,y))return 'shelf_access_left';
// Freestanding rows, shelf islands (including 4-cell group) and
// single strips accessible from both sides use the open promo pontoon.
return 'shelf_island';
}

function shelfClusters(){
const vis=new Set(), groups=[];
for(let y=0;y<H;y++)for(let x=0;x<W;x++){
if(!isShelfTile(x,y)||vis.has(k(x,y)))continue;
const todo=[[x,y]],cells=[],key=k(x,y);vis.add(key);
while(todo.length){
const [cx,cy]=todo.pop();cells.push([cx,cy]);
for(const [dx,dy] of DIRS){const nx=cx+dx,ny=cy+dy,kk=k(nx,ny);
if(isShelfTile(nx,ny)&&!vis.has(kk)){vis.add(kk);todo.push([nx,ny]);}
}
}
const xs=cells.map(p=>p[0]),ys=cells.map(p=>p[1]);
const minx=Math.min(...xs),miny=Math.min(...ys),maxx=Math.max(...xs),maxy=Math.max(...ys);
groups.push({x:minx,y:miny,w:maxx-minx+1,h:maxy-miny+1,cells});
}
return groups;
}
